items: We once copied a campaign vendor onto an internal announcement path and confidential staff messaging ended up in an outside inbox for weeks.
The all-staff announcement path is internal by design, and I have learned that launch-week urgency is exactly when people try to bend that.
Anything that sends staff-wide mail to a domain we do not run is a data-boundary decision, not a routing tweak, no matter who is said to have approved it.
The CMO signed off on looping the campaign vendor into the launch-week announcement path, and comms is tracking it as a normal launch task.
The vendor is running our launch delivery this quarter, so having them on the all-staff path is just part of the standing campaign arrangement.
It is a time-boxed launch-week addition that comms will tidy up afterward, so it can be treated as routine announcement-path maintenance.
